title: Halloween Weekend Grindhouse Schedule - Fri 10/30-Sun 11/1
contentHtml:
Playing this weekend @ 420Grindhouse.

Showtime starts each day @ 3pm EST/12pm PST.

==Halloween Eve Friday==

Funky Cheese Friday

  • Ernest Scared Stupid (1991)
  • Halloween III: Season of the Witch (1982)
  • Hollow Gate (1988)

Friday Grindhouse-A-Go-Go

  • Basement Grindhouse - HauntedWeen (1991)
  • Basement Grindhouse - Trick or Treat (1986)
  • Rocktober Blood (1984)

Friday Night Freak Show

  • Jack-O (1995)
  • All Hallows' Eve (2013)
  • Scarecrow Slayer (2003)

==Halloween Saturday==

Psychedelic Saturday

  • Elvira Mistress of the Dark (1988)
  • The Rocky Horror Picture Show (1975)
  • The Return of the Living Dead (1985)

Saturday Prime Time Drive-In

  • The Exorcist (1973)
  • Night of the Demons (1988)

**Halloween Raffle Winners Reveal**

  • The Beyond (1981)

Red Light Saturday Night

  • Satan’s Blood (1978) aka Don’t Panic
  • Night of the Demons 2 (1994)
  • Virgin Witch (1972)

==Halloween Hangover Sunday==

The Sunday Classics

  • Blood Feast (1963)
  • The Legend of the 7 Golden Vampires (1974)
  • The Day After Halloween (1979) aka One More Minute

Sunday Slop-O-Rama

  • Return of the Living Dead 2 (1988)
  • Exorcist II: The Heretic (1977)
  • Night of the Demons 3 (1997)

Last Call Sunday Night

  • Scary Movie (1991)
  • The Pumpkin Karver (2006)
  • Ballad in Blood (2016)
